t: Espressif's high-end wireless chip for voice, touch screens, and smart home hubs.
steps: Buy an ESP32-S31-Function-CoreBoard-1 from Espressif's AliExpress store, DigiKey, or Mouser.
Install Visual Studio Code and the Espressif ESP-IDF extension.
Set up ESP-IDF version 6.1.1 or newer and choose esp32s31 as the target.
Plug the board into your computer with a USB-C cable.
Build and flash the hello_world example.
Open the serial monitor and read the board's greeting.
Try a Wi-Fi station example to join your home network.
meta: Open Board. From $59. A few stores.
